title: GUNS TAKE A MOMENT TO DRAW
why: His order of 2026-10-14: "different guns should have different pull out / ready to fire times". A gun that comes into your hands now needs a moment before it fires, and the moment depends on the gun: a pistol is ready in a quarter of a second, a submachine gun in 0.4, a rifle in 0.55, a shotgun in 0.6, a marksman rifle in 0.7, a sniper rifle in 0.85, and the machine gun and the lance take a full second. It counts on every swap, every draw from the backpack and every pickup, and the same time applies to a Forge upgraded gun. A fresh raid starts with the gun already drawn, and the bot never waits. This is the first step of the item wheel: the same clock will time the gun coming back after a grenade or a heal.
now: Guns now take a moment to draw: a pistol is ready fast, a sniper rifle or the machine gun takes nearly a second.
